fn: Team Schedule, Swap shifts: drag across days in a row (works with a finger too), then drag the same number of days on another row, or tap another row name, and the two rows trade those days in one step. Tap a row name first to take the whole month. Undo reverses the whole swap. Single-slot swaps still work.
ds: Team Schedule (Geologist and Core Checkers): same drag and row swap.
